entries.name: District FMO - Eastern MT/Dakotas (from 2026 flyer)
entries.text:
This is an exciting opportunity to serve as the District Fire Management Officer and help shape the future of wildland fire management for the Bureau of Land Management and the U.S. Wildland Fire Service in Eastern Montana and the Dakotas. This role offers the chance to lead and influence a dynamic fire program during a period of transformation, while working alongside an exceptional and dedicated group of fire professionals. The District FMO plays a key leadership role in fostering and strengthening excellent interagency relationships, working closely with federal, state, tribal, and local partners to deliver effective, coordinated fire management across shared landscapes.

Montana and the Dakotas offer an exceptional quality of life with strong community connections, a culture of collaboration, and unparalleled landscapes, along with abundant outdoor recreational opportunities — such as hiking, hunting, fishing, and skiing — and close proximity and access to expansive public lands.
